description: This file is a service worker script implementing an offline-first caching strategy for a web application. It handles installation, activation, and fetch events to cache specific URLs and serve cached content when offline or in case of fetch failures.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the service worker installation, pre-caching the shell URLs and skipping waiting to activate immediately.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Handles activation, ensuring old caches are removed and the service worker takes control of clients.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Intercepts network requests to serve cached content based on request type and URL, implementing cache-first strategies and fallback for navigation requests.
